sources.title: slippedJim/K3_draft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A DSpark draft model for speculative decoding with moonshotai/Kimi-K3, trained with on-policy speculative distillation. The file layout, tensor names and config.json are identical to Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark, so this is a drop-in replacement for it — only the weights differ.
